name: Namaiki Imouto o Choukyou Shitatta
original_name: 生意気妹を調教したった
source:
Everybody thinks my little sister Yuuki is just so cute.
And sure, they're not wrong -- she's got a big tits and a pretty face, after all.
But her personality... she's just such a bitch! Even today, we had a pretty bad fight.

Well anyway, just watch.
I'll sort her out.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ311662.html]DLsite English [/url]]
translation:
大家都觉得我的妹妹优希很可爱。
当然，他们没有错——毕竟她有一个大乳房和一张漂亮的脸。
但她的性格……简直就是个贱人！即使今天，我们还是打了一场非常糟糕的争吵。

好吧，无论如何，只是看着。
我会安排她。
